text:
Jordan (Support): FYI opened incident for a hosted inference spike — multiple customers reporting 5xx and client-side timeouts on /v1/generate around 21:03 UTC. Kicking off quick sync. link: https://internal/incident/1769805432
Olivia (SRE): I'm in the incident channel. seeing p95 latency jump and 502/504 bursts from the gateway logs. attaching short grep:
```
gateway | ts=2026-02-12T21:03:12Z level=error code=502 upstream=hosted-inference-01 msg=502 from backend
runtime | ts=2026-02-12T21:03:14Z level=warn queue_wait_ms=1200 request_id=abc123
```
Sam (Runtime): noticed batcher queue depth spike and some workers hitting KV cache miss storms. suspecting large prefix churn + long sequences. can we rollback recent runtime change? Maria (Platform): No infra deploys at 21:00. only a config tweak to autoscaler at 20:45 (scale-down cooldown lowered). Could be related. Aisha (Customer Success): Customer "LangCloud" reported ~30% failed requests (5xx) and timeouts in EU region, they are escalated. Jordan (Support): Thanks. Olivia, Sam — can you confirm whether we had any model swap or quantization push in last 24h? Sam (Runtime): No model changes. Last model onboarding was earlier this week. only config that touched autoscale/cooldown as Maria noted. Olivia (SRE): I'm enabling increased logging on gateway and bumping circuit-breaker thresholds temporarily. deploy-bot: @Olivia deployed gateway-logging:v2 to staging, prod rollout in progress. Olivia (SRE): Rolling out logging and a small circuit-breaker relaxation to reduce hard 502s. will watch 2 minutes. Sam (Runtime): Started tailing runtime logs, reproducer script shows long tail tokens causing kv-cache growth:
```
for i in $(seq 1 50); do curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"long sequence...","max_tokens":2000}'; done
```
Sam (Runtime): Noting that batching thresholds are backlogged due to many long requests. Recommend temporary per-request max_tokens cap at edge to protect batching. Maria (Platform): I can flip a per-route quota to limit max_tokens to 1024 for hosted tier for 10m. approve? Jordan (Support): Approve — communicate to CS that customers may see token truncation for 10m. Aisha (Customer Success): I'll notify LangCloud and any other open escalations with a short note. Olivia (SRE): Applied circuit-breaker relax + increased gateway worker concurrency + enabled extra logs. early signals: 60% drop in 502s, p95 latency improving. Sam (Runtime): Kicked runtime worker autoscale up for affected pool; batch queue drained. seeing KV miss ratio drop. Olivia (SRE): Summary: mitigation = relax circuit-breakers, increase worker concurrency, autoscale runtime pool, apply short max_tokens cap at edge. All reduced errors. Jordan (Support): Great. let's capture follow-ups/action items. Sam (Runtime): Action: add a runtime guard to reject single-request token lengths > 3000 with clear 4xx and telemetry (owner: Sam) — due EOD. Maria (Platform): Action: revert cooldown change and add a safety throttle on scale-down (owner: Maria) — due next week. Olivia (SRE): Action: build alert for rapid KV cache miss rate and batch backlog > threshold (owner: Olivia) — due 3 days. Aisha (Customer Success): Action: send post-incident customer update + offer 1:1 assist (owner: Aisha) — today. Jordan (Support): Action: include a short repro playbook in incident doc and add sample cURL (owner: Jordan) — today. Sam (Runtime): Note for postmortem: need to test long-sequence workload in canary and add per-route rejects rather than silent truncation. also consider prefix-based caching TTL adjustments. Maria (Platform): I'll schedule a small config rollback and a runbook for cooldown changes. Olivia (SRE): We should follow up with an incident postmortem doc — include timeline, root cause hypothesis (scale-down cooldown + long-seq workload -> batcher backlog -> kv-cache churn -> 502s), mitigations applied, and permanent fixes. Jordan (Support): I can draft the customer-facing summary after we agree wording. Quick timeline to include in doc:
- 21:03 UTC: spike observed and first customer report
- 21:05 UTC: incident declared and SRE/runtime paged
- 21:08 UTC: initial mitigations (circuit relax, increase concurrency) applied
- 21:12 UTC: autoscale and runtime pool bumped, errors dropping
- 21:18 UTC: per-route token cap applied, stability restored
Olivia (SRE): last logs look clean; leaving alert noise suppression for 30m while we verify. Jordan (Support): Great work everyone. We'll reconvene for formal postmortem tomorrow 10:00 UTC. Please add any additional notes to the incident doc. :thumbsup:
